import pandas as pd, glob
rows=[]
for f in glob.glob('airlines/*.csv'):
 d=pd.read_csv(f); d['carrier']=f.split('/')[-1].split('.')[0]
 # identify fields and parse date/time as given; difference across midnight
 datecol='date_utc' if 'date_utc' in d else 'date'; s='sched_dep_utc' if 'sched_dep_utc' in d else 'sched_dep'; a='actual_dep_utc' if 'actual_dep_utc' in d else 'actual_dep'
 d['sched_dt']=pd.to_datetime(d[datecol]+' '+d[s], errors='coerce', utc=True)
 d['actual_dt']=pd.to_datetime(d[datecol]+' '+d[a], errors='coerce', utc=True)
 d['delay']=(d['actual_dt']-d['sched_dt']).dt.total_seconds()/60
 rows.append(d)
x=pd.concat(rows,ignore_index=True)
print('rows',len(x),'unique ids',x.flight_id.nunique(),'dupes',x.flight_id.duplicated().sum())
print('cancel values',x.cancelled.value_counts(dropna=False).to_dict(),'missing delay completed',x.loc[~x.cancelled,'delay'].isna().sum())
print(x.loc[~x.cancelled,'delay'].describe())
print('sum/count/mean',x.loc[~x.cancelled,'delay'].sum(),x.loc[~x.cancelled,'delay'].count(),x.loc[~x.cancelled,'delay'].mean())
print('cross midnight candidates',x.loc[(~x.cancelled)&(x.delay.abs()>300),['flight_id','carrier','date_utc' if 'date_utc' in x else 'date','sched_dt','actual_dt','delay']].head())

# recompute with clock difference, rollover for raw <= -60, inspect duplicates
parts=[]
for f in glob.glob('airlines/*.csv'):
 d=pd.read_csv(f); d['carrier']=f.split('/')[-1].split('.')[0]
 s='sched_dep_utc' if 'sched_dep_utc' in d.columns else 'sched_dep'; a='actual_dep_utc' if 'actual_dep_utc' in d.columns else 'actual_dep'
 mins=lambda z: z.str[:2].astype(int)*60+z.str[3:5].astype(int)
 d['raw']=mins(d[a])-mins(d[s]); d['delay']=d['raw']+(d['raw']<=-60)*1440
 parts.append(d)
x=pd.concat(parts,ignore_index=True)
print('rollovers', (x.raw<=-60).sum(), 'raw min',x.raw.min(), 'delay stats',x.loc[~x.cancelled,'delay'].describe().to_dict())
print('all sum count mean',x.loc[~x.cancelled,'delay'].sum(),x.loc[~x.cancelled,'delay'].count(),x.loc[~x.cancelled,'delay'].mean())
print('duplicates sample')
print(x[x.flight_id.duplicated(False)].sort_values('flight_id')[['flight_id','carrier','cancelled','sched_dep' if 'sched_dep' in x else 'sched_dep_utc','actual_dep' if 'actual_dep' in x else 'actual_dep_utc','delay']].to_string(index=False))
